verdict.rationale: skills.sh is a registry and CLI that installs, updates and distributes SKILL.md instruction files into other agents' directories. It does not execute anything itself, so setting up autonomous background automations belongs to the agent or runtime layer, not to a skill package manager. Its non-interactive CI/CD install mode and the `skills use` flag that starts an agent interactively are installation and launch conveniences, not background automation, so they do not make this axis apply.
